T: You're terrible, Muriel. The food isn't.
D: A lonely young woman from Porpoise Spit dreams of a big white wedding and a life in Sydney.
P: Serve the cocktails when Muriel and Rhonda hit the island resort.
S: a seaside town on the Queensland coast
Cooked king prawns peeled, piled into glasses over shredded iceberg with a sauce of mayo, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, lemon and a dash of hot sauce, a lemon wedge on the rim.
Puff pastry cases baked at 200C, filled with chicken and mushroom in a creamy white sauce with tarragon and a squeeze of lemon, warmed through before serving.

Pineapple, mango, papaya and lychees on crushed ice with lime cheeks, a chilli lime salt and a passionfruit and coconut yoghurt dip. Peel and cut 1 pineapple and 2 mangoes into wedges, slice half a papaya and peel 250g lychees. Arrange over a tray of crushed ice with 2 limes cut into cheeks. Mix 1 tbsp sea salt with half a tsp chilli powder and the zest of 1 lime. Stir the pulp of 3 passionfruit into 200g coconut yoghurt with 1 tbsp honey. Serve the salt and dip on the side.
M: the alternate drop at every Aussie wedding reception

Every second guest gets chicken breast in creamy mushroom sauce, the rest get eye fillet with red wine jus, both with dauphinoise and green beans. Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes with 300ml cream, garlic and salt and bake at 180C for 60 minutes. Sear 2 chicken breasts and 2 eye fillet steaks. Roast the chicken at 200C for 15 minutes and the beef 8 minutes, then rest. In one pan cook 200g mushrooms, add 150ml cream. In another reduce 125ml red wine with 200ml beef stock. Steam 300g green beans. Plate alternately.
Sweet and sour pork: pork shoulder in a light batter, fried at 180C, tossed in a sauce of pineapple, capsicum, vinegar, sugar and tomato sauce. Steamed rice.
W: three tiers of white, the dream
Vanilla butter cake baked at 165C, layered with raspberry jam and buttercream, covered in white fondant, a few fresh flowers on top. Serve in fingers.
K: White rum blended with pineapple, coconut cream and lime into a thick frozen colada, poured into tall glasses with a pineapple wedge and umbrella. Put 180ml white rum, 250ml pineapple juice, 150ml coconut cream, 60ml lime juice and 1 tbsp sugar syrup into a blender with 4 cups of ice. Blend until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall glasses and garnish each with a pineapple wedge, a cocktail cherry and a paper umbrella. Swap the rum for extra pineapple juice to make it alcohol-free.

s.note: a seaside town on the Queensland coast
s.how: Peel 500g cooked king prawns. Mix 120g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, a squeeze of lemon and a dash of hot sauce. Shred half an iceberg lettuce into four glasses, pile on the prawns, spoon over the sauce and hang a lemon wedge on each rim.

Cut 16 rounds from 2 sheets puff pastry, press a smaller ring into each and bake at 200C for 12 minutes, then push down the centres. Fry 250g diced chicken thighs and 150g chopped mushrooms in butter, add 200ml cream, 1 tbsp chopped tarragon and a squeeze of lemon and simmer until thick. Fill the cases and warm through for 3 minutes.

m.how: Cut 600g pork shoulder into cubes, toss in 1 tbsp soy, then in 80g cornflour, and fry at 180C until crisp. In a wok, fry 1 red capsicum and 200g pineapple pieces for 2 minutes, add 3 tbsp white vinegar, 3 tbsp sugar, 4 tbsp tomato sauce and 100ml water and thicken with 1 tsp cornflour. Toss the pork through and serve with 400g steamed jasmine rice.

w.note: three tiers of white, the dream
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g caster sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 300g self-raising flour with 125ml milk. Bake in two 20cm tins at 165C for 35 minutes and cool. Sandwich with 150g raspberry jam and buttercream of 150g butter and 300g icing sugar, coat thinly, then cover with 500g rolled white fondant and add a few fresh flowers. Serve in fingers.

d.how: Put 180ml white rum, 250ml pineapple juice, 150ml coconut cream, 60ml lime juice and 1 tbsp sugar syrup into a blender with 4 cups of ice. Blend until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall glasses and garnish each with a pineapple wedge, a cocktail cherry and a paper umbrella. Swap the rum for extra pineapple juice to make it alcohol-free.
